notes.title: Colored Effects will launch June 22
notes.notes: I am happy to announce that Colored Effects will be launching on June 22nd! Get ready for some action and puzzle solving. Thank you for all the support !

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Save Point : A save point has been added to each level, allowing players to save their progress and restart from that point at any time.
[*] Confirmation Dialog : When the player presses the Restart button, a confirmation dialog will appear, asking if they are sure they want to restart the level. This should help prevent players from accidentally restarting the level and losing their progress.
[*]Button Prompt : When the player can interact with an object, a button prompt will appear. This feature should make it easier for players to know when they can interact with objects in the game world (can be changed in the Options menu).
[*] The time window in which the player can jump after leaving a platform has been extended. This should make it easier for players to jump between platforms and avoid falling instantly.
[*] Fix minor bugs.
[/list]

Overall, these changes should improve the player experience and make the game more enjoyable to play.
Thank you for playing
